children: Phathom Pharmaceuticals said the FDA opened a public docket on legal and regulatory questions related to a challenge to VOQUEZNA’s NCE exclusivity through May 3, 2032.
The docket concerns BDR’s litigation challenging the FDA’s rejection of its ANDA referencing VOQUEZNA tablets.
Comments are due November 23, 2026; Phathom said it will submit comments supporting the FDA’s exclusivity decision.
Saba, a second purported ANDA filer, says it has a related pending case and intends to seek consolidation with BDR’s litigation.
